content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Allentown

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and documented work hours leading teams or managing projects. PMI sets specific thresholds; Granite PM Academy's admissions team will review your profile before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all required formal education sessions synchronously with experienced instructors. This structured coursework covers the PMBOK Guide framework and prepares you directly for PMI's examination standards.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your official PMI credential application and pay the associated examination fee. Document your project experience and education through PMI's portal. Our team can guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and completeness.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and strategy sessions. Schedule your proctored exam when you feel confident. Our instructors remain available to clarify complex topics and reinforce readiness before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn continuing professional development units (PDUs) over PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Engage in training, volunteer work, or professional activities that strengthen your project-management expertise. Renew with PMI before your credential expires to remain certified.
